title: Pattern: third breaker trip, a lasting fix is proposed
description: Third time F3 trips at the harbour hut this autumn. Liisa proposes a lasting fix (the dehumidifier on its own circuit) but the workaround is applied again. The recurring pattern shows the proposal as not yet done.
subject: #field-ops

incident.summary: RAD-254 down for the third time

messages.text: RAD-254 down. F3 tripped. Third time this autumn I think?
↳ reset F3 and empty the tray, you know the drill
↳ we keep doing this. someone should rewire the dehumidifier onto its own circuit so it can't take F3 down. I'll raise it with facilities
↳ F3 reset, tray emptied, radio up ✅

items.summary: When RAD-254 at the Turku harbour hut is completely dead, breaker F3 has usually tripped; reset it and empty the dehumidifier tray before replacing the radio.
items.diagnosis: the dehumidifier trips breaker F3 in heavy sea fog
items.action: Reset breaker F3 in the cabinet left of the door and empty the dehumidifier tray; check that the radio comes back before replacing it.
items.evidence: seq 4: 'F3 reset, tray emptied, radio up'

items.summary: Proposed lasting fix at the Turku harbour hut: put the dehumidifier on its own circuit so it cannot trip breaker F3 and take RAD-254 down.
items.diagnosis: the dehumidifier shares breaker F3 with the radio
items.action: Rewire the dehumidifier onto its own circuit so it cannot trip F3.
